Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Oathbound
Description: A consent-based collar control plugin. An Owner sends outfit, title, gesture, and follow/leash commands as ordinary in-game tells - no server, no hosting; the Sub's own client watches for them and applies them locally via Glamourer, Honorific, and Penumbra, and existing sync tooling propagates the result to everyone paired with the Sub.
Punchline: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.
